name: Colony's End
description: A huge ruined colonizer ship embedded in a mountain with intact tanks.

description_citations.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
description_citations.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint explores Colony's End, a huge metal ruin.
timeline.quote: The place the Oltec called Colony's End jutted from the side of a mountain

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint recalls the Oltec story of colonizers whose vessels caged Chimil.
timeline.quote: Their stories described giants whose great, dark vessels appeared in the sky, blotting out the light of Chimil and then caging her within a metal prison.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint finds coin bas-reliefs at the entrance to the ruin.
timeline.quote: bas-reliefs depicting the same coin motifs he'd discovered elsewhere.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint finds a room of shattered tanks and one intact tank.
timeline.quote: this one held a long row of massive tanks, their glass fronts shattered

timeline.summary: Quint's touch lights up the intact tank, revealing a huge creature.

timeline.summary: The creature in the tank flexes its hand into a fist.
